description: Assembly gives small instructions to a processor. These lessons use Linux exit codes to see simple results. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. On x86-64 Linux, save lesson.asm. Run nasm -f elf64 lesson.asm -o lesson.o, then ld lesson.o -o lesson. Run ./lesson, then printf 'exit code: %s\n' "$?" immediately.
versionNote: Examples use NASM syntax for x86-64 Linux; they are not ARM or Windows assembly.
whatYouWillLearn: Return a small result with Assembly
Save and restore a value with Assembly
learningObjectives: Return a small result with Assembly
Repeat with a counter with Assembly
